$comment: Skills the hero-mmt-kit workflow references. The `process` core skills are bundled under templates/skills/ and installed by init/update into .claude/skills/. Concise reporting principles are integrated directly into the hero-* workflow skills rather than shipped as a standalone optional skill. Vendored technique skills are curated, lightly trimmed MIT-licensed copies from obra/superpowers; the hero-* skills plus using-hero are authored by hero-mmt-kit and may incorporate attributed MIT methodology (attribution: templates/skills/NOTICE). Design/taste skills are NOT bundled — they are referenced here and installed via the `skills` CLI from their ORIGINAL sources when the user opts into the taste/design skill.

process.license: MIT for obra/superpowers skills; hero-mmt-kit authored for the hero-* skills and using-hero
process.description: Core process skills the workflow invokes by name. Bundled under templates/skills/ and installed into .claude/skills/ by init/update. The hero-* skills are the primary developer-facing interface and define narrow stage contracts; broader vendored techniques remain available but must not override those boundaries (attribution in templates/skills/NOTICE).

selection.installPolicy: install the full bundled process suite unconditionally — every install gets all core skills
selection.updatePolicy: refresh all framework-managed bundled process skills; preserve user-added skill directories

skills.name: using-hero
skills.description: Overview and router for the hero-* skills — explains which skill to invoke next and how workflow state carries across sessions.

skills.name: hero-planning
skills.description: Clarify requirements through analysis and brainstorming, then write an implementation-only plan with requirement-to-task coverage.

skills.name: hero-coding
skills.description: Implement and track every requirement/task in an approved plan or small bounded request; no testing or self-review.

skills.name: hero-reviewing
skills.description: Conduct a plan-backed, read-only review, assess supplied review feedback, or explicitly do both without applying fixes.

skills.name: hero-unit-test
skills.description: Write and run post-implementation unit tests from approved requirements without changing production code.

skills.name: hero-security
skills.description: Run an independent OWASP + AI/LLM security review and write a standalone security report.

skills.name: hero-mr-review
skills.description: Review a teammate's merge request by commit/tag/branch and write a standalone MR review report.

skills.name: hero-strict
skills.description: Opt-in full verification pass before a "done" claim.

skills.name: hero-report
skills.description: On-demand report writer — writes the coding/review/test report at the source skill's conventional path, only when requested.

brand.description: Brand/identity skill. Use once per product/brand.

design-direction.description: Visual-direction taste systems. Pick EXACTLY ONE per project (DESIGN_STANDARDS §3).

design-tools.description: Complementary design tools — install as needed (not mutually exclusive).
